components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddress"
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and, on read,
            holds the composed address: when structured fields are supplied it is the normalized
            addressLine1 with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present;
            otherwise the normalized flat input.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized and, when
            present, appended to addressLine1 to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NotDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already shares its
            household (same last name and postcode); the owner is recorded as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted as the title followed by a space and the last name
                when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the postcode's fixed range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), matching the leading '<REGION>' segment of the memberId, or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: Stable identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the region derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household (same last name and postcode), derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and the postcode. Assigned whenever the owner has a postcode, so members share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, one of 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, the SHA-256 hex of '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<Soundex of last name>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation time, shared an existing owner's postcode and last-name Soundex while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on postcode and last-name Soundex, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any risk signal holds: the owner is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known
                disposable provider's second-level label, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain), or
                its city was over its soft capacity (the 40-owner warning threshold) when the owner
                was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id} (the record is retained but excluded from the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks), otherwise false. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        totalElements:

          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: User not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddress"
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and, on read,
            holds the composed address: when structured fields are supplied it is the normalized
            addressLine1 with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present;
            otherwise the normalized flat input.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized and, when
            present, appended to addressLine1 to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NotDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already shares its
            household (same last name and postcode); the owner is recorded as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted as the title followed by a space and the last name
                when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the postcode's fixed range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range. The plain region, never carrying the identity version tag.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract, currently 2. The memberId, identityKey and householdId are grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: Stable identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the region derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D9'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household (same last name and postcode), derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and the postcode. Assigned whenever the owner has a postcode, so members share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, one of 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, the SHA-256 hex of '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<Soundex of last name>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation time, shared an existing owner's postcode and last-name Soundex while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on postcode and last-name Soundex, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any risk signal holds: the owner is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known
                disposable provider's second-level label, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain), or
                its city was over its soft capacity (the 40-owner warning threshold) when the owner
                was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id} (the record is retained but excluded from the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks), otherwise false. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

    PetPage:

      description: A page of pets.
      type: object

        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

          format: int32

    PetTypeFields:

    Role:

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddress"
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and, on read,
            holds the composed address: when structured fields are supplied it is the normalized
            addressLine1 with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present;
            otherwise the normalized flat input.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized and, when
            present, appended to addressLine1 to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NotDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already shares its
            household (same last name and postcode); the owner is recorded as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted as the title followed by a space and the last name
                when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the postcode's fixed range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range. The plain region, never carrying the identity version tag.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract, currently 2. The memberId, identityKey and householdId are grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, one of 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, the SHA-256 hex of '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<Soundex of last name>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation time, shared an existing owner's postcode and last-name Soundex while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on postcode and last-name Soundex, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any risk signal holds: the owner is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known
                disposable provider's second-level label, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain), or
                its city was over its soft capacity (the 40-owner warning threshold) when the owner
                was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id} (the record is retained but excluded from the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks), otherwise false. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddress"
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and, on read,
            holds the composed address: when structured fields are supplied it is the normalized
            addressLine1 with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present;
            otherwise the normalized flat input.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized and, when
            present, appended to addressLine1 to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NotDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's
            region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already shares its
            household (same last name and postcode); the owner is recorded as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted as the title followed by a space and the last name
                when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the postcode's fixed range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range. The plain region, never carrying the identity version tag.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract, currently 2. The memberId, identityKey and householdId are grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, one of 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel
                is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation time, shared an existing owner's postcode and last-name Soundex while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on postcode and last-name Soundex, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any risk signal holds: the owner is a
                possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known
                disposable provider's second-level label, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain), or
                its city was over its soft capacity (the 40-owner warning threshold) when the owner
                was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id} (the record is retained but excluded from the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks), otherwise false. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity, keeping each change in the unit responsible for it:

**Identity derivation (V2 tag mixed in)**
- New `util/OwnerIdentityVersion` owns the version number (`2`), the fixed `"V2"` tag, and the two mixing rules: `regionCode(plainRegion)` (appends the tag → `NSWV2`) and `stampHashInput(input)` (prefixes `V2|` before hashing). This is the single source of the version policy, reused everywhere.
- `MemberIdGenerator` now embeds the V2 region code in the `<REGION>` segment.
- `HouseholdIdGenerator` and `Owner.getIdentityKey()` now hash the V2-stamped input.
- Because the tag can never appear at those positions under v1, no v1 value is reproduced.

**Response shape**
- `openapi.yml`: removed top-level `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId`, added a nested `OwnerIdentity` schema grouping them, added an integer `apiVersion`, and clarified that `locality` is the plain region.
- `OwnerMapper` maps `apiVersion` and builds the `identity` object; `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment` remain plain-region derived.

**Audit schema + owner segment**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` moved to schema version 2: added `schemaVersion` (2) and `ownerSegment`.
- `OwnerAuditor` recomputes the owner segment via the mapper and includes it; the event's `memberId` is now the V2 value automatically.

Request fields (`OwnerFields`) were left untouched. `mvn -o test` → BUILD SUCCESS.
